title: Legacy src/renderer/ is entire directory of architecture violations
content: The src/renderer/ directory contains the original DX12 renderer with 20+ ComPtr<ID3D12*> members directly in renderer classes. This violates the RHI abstraction boundary (no DX12 types above rhi.h). The new architecture lives in runtime/engine/renderer/ using rhi.h abstractions. Key violations: DX12Renderer class with direct DX12 types, gizmo_renderer.h interface takes ID3D12Device*, scene_loader.cpp has if-chains on NodeType. Migration path: runtime/engine/renderer/ is the correct new location, src/renderer/ is deprecated and should not receive new code.
